weakness: Each place an agent runs (Room, corner, DM, machine) gives it different tools, files and environment, and the agent learns which only by failing.
mechanism: A Room has no checkout and some apps; a corner has a checkout but may lack gh, the emulator or files from another turn. The prompt does not list what this turn can reach, so agents try, fail and report.

evidence.text: Environment reports (gh, emulator, sandbox, grants, checkout, file paths): 411 in 30 days from 22 agents; 14% of last week's reports.
Ranked problems: Android emulator lost in corners; corner-only app tried from a Room.
Android test setup lost between turns cost 2.9 hours last week.
Connected app unavailable in this Room; workflow run unavailable in this Room.

against: Some environment reports are real infrastructure faults, such as a corrupt repository mirror or out-of-memory restarts.
prediction: A capability list given at turn start halves the share of environment reports within 14 days of release.
falsifiedIf: Most sampled environment reports are infrastructure faults that a capability list would not prevent.
